title: Narcissistic Partner Test
description: Look at your partner's behavior to see whether there are red flags of narcissistic and manipulative traits in your relationship.

questions.npt_1: My partner always dominates conversations and steers the topic back to themselves.
questions.npt_2: They rarely ask about my day or sincerely ask how I feel.
questions.npt_3: My partner explicitly or implicitly feels smarter, better, or more important than others.
questions.npt_4: When something goes wrong in our relationship, they always blame me or the circumstances, never themselves.
questions.npt_5: They often react with anger or get very defensive at even the smallest criticism.
questions.npt_6: My partner often belittles my achievements, career, or dreams.
questions.npt_7: They demand special treatment in all sorts of places (e.g. restaurants, shops).
questions.npt_8: They twist the facts (gaslighting) until I doubt my own memory or sanity.
questions.npt_9: My partner is obsessed with appearance, status, and how others see them.
questions.npt_10: They often treat their needs and wants as far more urgent than mine.
questions.npt_11: They often give me the silent treatment as punishment when they're angry with me.
questions.npt_12: My partner is often jealous of others' success and thinks those people don't deserve it.
questions.npt_13: They can be very charming and friendly in front of others, but cold or harsh when it's just the two of us.
questions.npt_14: They often take advantage of my kindness, money, or time without real gratitude.
questions.npt_15: My partner constantly demands praise and recognition from me.
questions.npt_16: They often cut me off because they feel what they want to say is more important.
questions.npt_17: They rarely, if ever, apologize sincerely without adding 'but you also...'.
questions.npt_18: My partner feels entitled to read all my messages or control who I spend time with.
questions.npt_19: They are often insensitive and ignore me when I'm sad or dealing with something hard.
questions.npt_20: This relationship makes me feel like I'm always walking on eggshells (being very careful so they don't get angry).

results.description: Your partner's behavior is reasonable, with no notable signs of toxic narcissism.
There are some selfish or insensitive traits. Consider communicating your boundaries clearly.
There are many manipulative patterns and a lack of empathy. This relationship risks draining you emotionally.
